articles.description: Candace Owens has opened up about how her feelings changed following Charlie Kirk’s assassination. She said she has moved beyond the initial trauma and no longer feels haunted, instead believing Kirk is spiritually “fighting alongside” her. articles.title: Amazon AI Opt-Out Backlash: Twitch auto-enables training on streams; creators must change privacy settings
articles.description: Twitch is facing criticism over a new setting that allows Amazon to use streamer content for generative AI training by default. Streamers can opt out through their privacy settings. Users questioned why the option was not turned off unless creators agreed. Twitch said it is not training GenAI models itself, but the setting covers Amazon’s AI model training.

articles.title: Paranormal Creator’s Fatal Crash: Jiang Xiaorou dies after July accident; family urges fans to stop speculation
articles.description: Jiang Xiaorou, a 24-year-old Chinese paranormal content creator, died on August 10 after suffering severe injuries in a July 15 traffic accident. Known for challenging superstition, she had more than 1.28 million Douyin followers. Her controversial videos, including one showing her destroying a Guanyin statue, resurfaced after her death. However, there is no evidence linking her accident to supernatural punishment, despite speculation circulating online.

articles.title: Precious metals price today: Gold slips after two-month high; silver also declines
articles.full_text: Spot gold fell 0.5% to $4,330.37 per ounce by 0103 GMT on Friday as investors locked in profits after bullion climbed to its highest level since June 5 in the previous session. US gold futures for December delivery also declined 0.8% to $4,386.80.

articles.title: Oil prices today: Crude edges higher as US-Iran tensions revive supply concerns
articles.description: Oil prices saw a slight increase on Friday due to renewed supply concerns. The United States threatened an indefinite naval blockade of Iran, escalating economic pressure. This action heightened worries about potential disruptions to crude oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz. However, weaker demand forecasts and rising US inventories limited the overall price gains. Conflicting supply and demand factors are currently keeping the oil market balanced.

articles.title: Batwara 1947 and Awarapan 2 Movie Review, Release Live Updates
articles.full_text: Surely #AWARAPAN2 is going to win in this race...#Batwara1947 is just not having any buzz…No one is seemingly interested in Batwaara, & if they could have included the song of Jannat – Lambi Judaai – in AWARAPAN...then Awarapan would have been even more successful Nearly two decades ago, Emraan Hashmi’s 'Awarapan' and Sunny Deol’s 'Apne' went head-to-head at the box office, with the latter emerging victorious in terms of collections. Both movies were released on June 29, 2007. As 'Awarapan 2' has hit theatres, Emraan Hashmi has started trending on X (formerly Twitter). Emraan Hashmi-starrer 'Awarapan 2' is currently ahead of 'Batwara 1947' in the advance booking race. The film has recorded Rs 8.57 crore in advance bookings, excluding blocked seats, with the figure rising to Rs 11.36 crore when blocked seats are included. The film has been directed by Rajkumar Santoshi, marking his reunion with Sunny Deol after decades.

articles.description: South Indian cinema continues its focus on visual impact and theatrical entertainment. Movies like Kaattalan, Athiradi, DC, and Blast showcase this style-driven approach. Directors skillfully use presentation to keep viewers entertained and invested.
